title: Welcome to OpenTechSummit India: Where Open Source Meets Decentralized Tech
description: Welcome to OpenTechSummit India at Devcon! In this short opening, we introduce the day. You'll hear what's happening in the talk track and the workshop room, how the sessions connect, and where to find the FOSSASIA team, mentors and project demos throughout the day. We'll also share practical information: how to join the hands-on workshops, where to try the LED badges and other open hardware, and how to connect with speakers and fellow builders. Whether you're here to learn, to meet people or to make your first contribution, this is where your day starts.
